Could each of you let me know: (1) What time works best for you that Saturday, and any hard stop times? (2) Any physical limits or things I should keep in mind when assigning tasks? (3) What tools or equipment do you already have available, or can bring? (4) Anything else that should shape how we organize the weeding, seed sorting, bed prep, and watering? I'll take everyone's input and then put together the task assignments and equipment plan.

transcript.text:
Thank you all for those important details! Let me make sure I've got everything straight before I put together the final plan:

• Jonah — got it, seed sorting at the folding table, nothing over 5 kg, no bed prep or tool hauling.
• Rina — you'll need to leave by 10:45 to get to Greenway Nursery by 11:15. I'll make sure your tasks are front-loaded.
• Cal — great catch on the Riverside Allotment Association notice. We'll plan watering with a drip line, and I'll add checking the shared tool shed for one to our equipment plan.
• Sofia — the rototiller window of 09:00–10:30 is tight but workable. We'll schedule bed prep right at the start to make the most of it.

Here's what I'm thinking for the schedule:

09:00–10:30: Bed prep with the rototiller (Sofia and Cal, since Jonah can't haul tools and Rina's time is limited). We'll prioritize getting the rototiller work done in this window.
09:00–10:45: Weeding in the raised beds and along the paved path (Rina can help here before she leaves).
09:00–12:00: Seed sorting at the folding table (Jonah, throughout the morning at a comfortable pace).
10:30–12:00: After the rototiller goes back, remaining weeding, bed prep finishing touches, and watering using the drip line.

One thing I want to confirm: does anyone know for sure whether the shared tool shed has a drip line available? If not, we should plan to source one before Saturday. Cal, since you saw the notice, do you have any additional details on that?

If this all sounds right, I'll finalize the assignments and equipment list. Any objections or adjustments?
